eyebrow: T-SQL for Database Administrators · Chapter One
subtitle: Lesson 5 · SQL Server Internals Through T-SQL

code:
SELECT session_id, login_name, host_name,
       program_name, status, login_time
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions
WHERE is_user_process = 1;
caption: sys.dm_exec_sessions — one row per logged-in session, real clients only.

code:
SELECT s.session_id, s.login_name, s.host_name,
       c.client_net_address, s.status,
       r.command, r.wait_type
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions AS s
JOIN sys.dm_exec_connections AS c
  ON c.session_id = s.session_id
LEFT JOIN sys.dm_exec_requests AS r
  ON r.session_id = s.session_id
WHERE s.is_user_process = 1;
caption: Sessions joined to connections and requests — the full picture in one query.
